_comment: Harness scope is executable, not a memo. States are not_started | active | blocked | passing. WIP=1 is enforced by scripts/verify-harness.ps1.

features.behavior: A fresh agent can identify the project, current phase, canonical instructions, architecture route, and verification command from repository files.
A fresh agent can resume from durable state, decisions, and a WIP-limited feature list without relying on chat history.
The repository has an executable completion contract that distinguishes the current harness gate from future runtime and end-to-end gates.

An operator can use the Dockerized FastAPI/PostgreSQL/Next.js stack to create a vendor, upload a COI-shaped document, verify normalized fields against deterministic requirements, review and correct exceptions, and retrieve an append-only point-in-time compliance status with audit evidence.
features.evidence: scripts/verify-mvp.ps1 passed on 2026-08-03: Dockerized PostgreSQL 16/FastAPI/Next.js flow created a vendor, uploaded a COI, produced needs_review, applied a human certificate-holder correction, produced compliant, retained 2 snapshots, and exposed 4 ledger events; frontend smoke returned HTTP 200. Backend pytest against Compose PostgreSQL: 6 passed.
